title: feat(cli,cloud-connection): OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL names the deployment's default map style
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X9ndwPy9fuaXy5hbjAwpdcG)_

Fixes #26001

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The server half of #26001 under ruling 6413991421 (letter A, operator env only). One environment variable names a deployment's default map style, so an intranet deployment, or one that forbids a third-party tile host, can stop depending on the public demo style host:

```sh
OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL=https://tiles.example.com/styles/basic/style.json
```

## What the one value does

1. **Runtime-config.** `RuntimeConfigPlugin` serves it verbatim as the top-level `mapStyleUrl` on `GET /api/v1/runtime/config` (and its legacy alias). Unset or empty, the key is absent, the same default-absent shape as `branding.stage` and `upgradeUrl`, and every other key is byte-identical. The payload's doc block declares the field.
2. **Console CSP.** The Console mount adds the URL's origin to the document's `connect-src`, read once at boot beside `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC`. The default demo host stays allowed when the env is set: a view may still name it in its own `mapStyle`, and a Console build that does not read `mapStyleUrl` yet still loads its built-in default.
3. **Refusals.** The value must be an absolute `https:` URL on a host name, with no user name, password or whitespace. Anything else refuses the boot with a message that names `OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL` (credentials are left out of the message). `RuntimeConfigPlugin` refuses from `start()`, not the constructor: the CLI's cloud wiring in `serve.ts` wraps the construction in a try/catch that turns a throw into a warning and a missing door.

No Setup setting, no settings-manifest key, no spec key, no per-request CSP, no `ui/**`, no `docs/adr/**`. Only the operator can widen the Console's `connect-src`.

**Name.** `OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL` follows AGENTS.md Prime Directive #9 for a config value (`OS_{DOMAIN}_{NAME}`), in the `CONSOLE` domain beside `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC`. The payload key is `mapStyleUrl`: the renderer sub-card reads it as its fallback before the demo style.

## One contract, two readers

The order asked for one value read by both sides. They cannot share code: `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` is published as `@objectstack/cli/console` and imports Node built-ins only, which `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` pins against the packed tarball (an import of `@objectstack/cloud-connection` reds it with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`, measured on the first push). So the contract lives in `packages/cloud-connection/src/console-map-style.ts` and the Console mount restates it as `readMapStyleOrigin`. `console.content-security-policy.test.ts` holds the two readers to the same verdict, refusal text included, on 11 values (4 accepted, 7 refused), and asserts that the CSP names the origin of the very URL the door serves.

## Two processes

- Single `os start`: the parent spawns `os serve` with its env, and both `RuntimeConfigPlugin` (CLI-wired or the host config's own) and the Console static plugin run in that child, reading the same `process.env` at start. They agree.
- `--no-console` / `OS_DISABLE_CONSOLE`: the door serves the URL and there is no Console document, so nothing can disagree.
- A runtime-host kernel (`ObjectOSEnvironmentPlugin` present): the CLI wires no `RuntimeConfigPlugin`, the host wires its own. They disagree only when the process that serves the Console document is not the one that serves `/api/v1/runtime/config` and the two carry different env. Then the CSP can name an origin the door does not serve (harmless), or the door can serve a URL the CSP blocks (a grey map). No such split exists in this repository.

## Tests (red first)

- `packages/cloud-connection/src/runtime-config-map-style.test.ts` (new): on `main` 10 failed / 3 passed (the 3 absence controls pass there, as they should); with the fix 13/13.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/console.content-security-policy.test.ts` (extended): on `main` 7 failed / 21 passed; with the fix 39/39, including the 11 parity cases.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): let the Console reader accept `http:` (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `912ed07b6027` to `aac41d764ec4`): 2 red (the boot refusal and the parity case for `http:`); restored, blob back to HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- At head `ef163a1bb`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test` 59 files / 745 tests passed; `typecheck` exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` 333 files / 4873 tests passed (the integration tier is declared to CI); `typecheck` exit 0. eslint over `packages/cli` and `packages/cloud-connection` with `--no-inline-config`: exit 0.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff, run at head `ef163a1bb`: 99 derived, 99 run, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 99 accounted for, 0 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. Four first exited 3 on prerequisites and were re-run once those were met: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (the positive-control commit fetched on this shallow clone), `check:i18n-coverage` (the example closure built), `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (a full `pnpm build`, 119/119 tasks).

## Live probe

`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh` after a full build and `pnpm console:build`, each server on its own port and stopped afterwards:

- `OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL=http://tiles.example.com/style.json`: the boot exits 1 with `Plugin com.objectstack.runtime.runtime-config failed to start - rollback complete: OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL is "http://tiles.example.com/style.json", which uses http: rather than https: ...`.
- `OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL=https://tiles.example.com/styles/basic/style.json`: `GET /api/v1/runtime/config` serves `mapStyleUrl` with that value (keys `cloudUrl, mapStyleUrl, singleEnvironment, features, branding, telemetry`), and `GET /_console/` answers 200 with `connect-src 'self' https://demotiles.maplibre.org https://tiles.example.com`.
- Env unset (control): no `mapStyleUrl` key, and `connect-src 'self' https://demotiles.maplibre.org`, as on `main`.

## Changeset

`.changeset/26001-console-map-style-url.md`, `patch` for `@objectstack/cloud-connection` and `@objectstack/cli`. The order said `minor`, but `Metadata-protocol: none` grades every entry `patch` under the level axis of `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (`none-minor` is exit 1), and the change adds no authorable key.

## Acceptance notes

- Not done here, by scope: the `ui/packages/plugin-map` renderer reading `mapStyleUrl` before its demo default. Until that lands, map views keep the built-in style. The seat files it as a `domain:ui` sub-card blocked by this card.
- A style whose tiles, sprites or glyphs live on other hosts still needs those hosts in `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC`; the env reference row says so.
- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx` gains the `OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL` row, and the `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC` row now lists its origin among the sources already allowed.
